newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major to unveil 5-point election plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major to unveil 5-point election plan - paper.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major is to unveil five pledges on the economy as part of his election drive, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.

Major's five promises will be to keep inflation low, to cut the basic rate of income tax to 20 percent, to keep mortgages affordable through low interest rates, to increase the number of people in jobs and to prevent Britain being tied into a federal Europe.
The paper said the pledges will be set out in a new year letter to more than 600 chairmen of local Conservative constituency associations -- the grassroots of the party.
Major's strategy would be coupled with Conservative attempts to convince voters that Britain's economic prospects would be threatened by a Labour government, the paper said.
Major has said he would not call an election for later than May 1, although May 22 is the last possible date.
